prompt: Create a complete, high-craft desktop webpage comp for Pak Hub, a public searchable Deep Rock Galactic pak library. Flat webpage fills a 1440x980 viewport, no browser or device frame. Same fixed DRG-inspired mine-operations-terminal world: coal-dark slate, warm metal neutrals, amber hazard yellow, restrained mineral teal, thin fine dividers, White Rabbit for the logo and short industrial headings, readable clean sans-serif for all body copy. No real game logos or characters, no gradients/glow/glass/textures, no invented download counts or compatibility claims. Show synthetic examples clearly labeled SAMPLE DATA. Composition C is a two-pane workbench, structurally different from a three-column filter/results/inspector or a full-width table: compact branded top bar; below it, a narrow horizontal search and category-control strip; then only two major working columns. Left column is a 28%-width compact searchable mod roster of dense selectable rows with title, category, latest version/date, and selected state. Right column is a spacious 72%-width selected mod dossier, with mod title and creator, brief summary, release history as a vertical chronological sequence, and clearly selectable file variants with sizes followed by one strong yellow DOWNLOAD PAK button. No separate left filter rail, no full-width ledger, no cards grid, no modal. Make the first viewport immediately show how to select a mod and choose between versions and file builds. Use fictional entries such as Lantern Rangefinder and Cave Echo Calibrator. Keep copy legible and the actual controls recognizable.
